note: The data inputs of the Explore pages (animations.html, 3d/index.html). Paths are relative to data/. Every set is aggregates only: means over at least 20 radar points with their spread; tools/check_data.py checks each set and that every view has its files unless it is listed as unavailable.

2020-2026-ground.name: 2020-2026, ground reference
2020-2026-ground.about: TerraSAR-X, the newer processing. Every movement is measured against the ground points the two processings share, the reference the team adopted on 5 October 2026, so a rate here means relative to the street, not an absolute movement.

unavailable.joint: Not built for this data set: the Rotterdam daily temperatures on hand end in December 2023, so the fit would cover only the first four of its six and a half years.

2014-2023-processor.name: 2014-2023, processor reference (archived September view)
2014-2023-processor.about: TerraSAR-X, the older processing, in the processor's own reference frame, as published in September 2026, before the shared-ground reference and the estimation pilot. Rates are relative to an unknown reference point. Where its readings differ from the Reference and Estimation pages, those pages hold; figure numbers refer to the retired September pages.
